items.title: Removed Dalen Terry from the cap sheet. Still one more move to go before KCP signing can fit under $209m hard cap.
items.author: Derek Bodner
items.body_excerpt:
Removed Dalen Terry from the cap sheet. Still one more move to go before KCP signing can fit under $209m hard cap. 

Jabari Walker is only non-gtd contract left. Trading Broome to a team that can absorb his contract, or stretching his contract, could get them under as well.

media.title: Sixers waive Dalen Terry in cost-cutting move to sign LeBron James and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
media.description: The Sixers needed to waive (or potentially trade) two players in order to sign James and Caldwell-Pope to stay under the first apron hard salary cap.
